drivers: Several US refinery coker restarts (Flint Hills, Valero) offset outages
Price down 16% in 3 months despite an October rally headline
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed: some outages and high freight rates, but many cokers are restarting. Supply pressure score is near zero and the price has fallen over 3 months, so no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf Coast coker run rates and freight rates for US petcoke exports.
drivers_zh: 多家美国炼厂焦化装置重启(Flint Hills、Valero),抵消部分停产影响
运费高企压制美国出口
尽管10月有上涨报道,但价格3个月下跌16%
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多空交织:有部分停产和高运费,但不少焦化装置已恢复运行。供应压力评分接近零,且价格3个月下跌,没有明确的短缺信号。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸焦化装置开工率及美国石油焦出口运费。

drivers: DRC export quotas; Glencore cobalt output down 52%
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are clearly cutting supply, with Glencore output roughly halved, and Chinese export-control risk adds to it. The 3-month price drop suggests the market is not fully pricing the shortage, though the 12-month gain is large.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota enforcement and China's decision on critical mineral export controls.
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额;嘉能可钴产量下降52%
中国出口管制期限临近
价格3个月已下跌24%
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额明显压缩供应,嘉能可产量近乎减半,中国出口管制风险进一步加码。3个月价格下跌说明市场可能尚未充分计入短缺,但12个月涨幅已较大。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额执行情况以及中国关键矿产出口管制的决定。

drivers: Major copper-moly producer slows molybdenum output growth
outlooks.summary: A major producer is slowing moly output growth and export-control risks persist. Prices have already risen strongly, so some of this may be priced in, but the bias is still upward.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and copper-miner moly output guidance.
drivers_zh: 大型铜钼生产商放缓钼产量增长
中国出口管制期限
价格3个月上涨18%
outlooks.summary_zh: 大型生产商放缓钼产量增长,出口管制风险犹存。价格已明显上涨,部分利好可能已被计入,但整体仍偏向上行。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定以及铜矿企业的钼产量指引。

drivers: Generic China export-control headlines, not lithium-specific
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly broad critical-mineral policy news with little lithium-specific supply loss. New upstream capacity and a falling price point to no clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and new lithium project start-ups.
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制新闻较泛,并非针对锂
宁德时代扩大上游锂资源布局
价格3个月下跌13%
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为关键矿产政策的泛泛报道,缺少锂的具体供应中断。上游新增产能和价格下跌显示没有明确短缺。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定及新锂项目投产情况。

drivers: Japan yttrium supply 'stalled' under Chinese controls
China extended export-control pause to January
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages for Japan show real supply tightness, but China's two-month extension of the pause eases near-term policy risk. Overall a modest upside bias, with the deadline in January a risk.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for China's decision before the January pause expiry and yttrium flows to Japan.
drivers_zh: 对日本的钇供应已“停滞”
中国将出口管制暂停延长至1月
价格12个月上涨36%
outlooks.summary_zh: 日本钇短缺显示供应确实偏紧,但中国将暂停期延长两个月,缓解了短期政策风险。整体略偏上行,1月到期是风险点。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注1月暂停期到期前中国的决定以及对日本的钇供应情况。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeezing supply
outlooks.summary: Supply disruptions in Congo and Indonesia, plus demand outpacing refined supply, point to tightness. Price is up 56% over 12 months but flat over 3 months, so further upside is plausible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo (Bisie) output and Indonesian export volumes.
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
需求增长快于精炼锡供应
中国出口管制期限
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果和印尼供应中断,加上需求增速超过精炼锡供应,显示市场偏紧。价格12个月上涨56%但近3个月持平,进一步上行仍有可能。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(Bisie)产量和印尼出口量。

outlooks.summary: Export-policy risks exist, but headlines are generic and the price is far below last year, suggesting ample supply for now.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline and any China export-control announcements.
drivers_zh: 出口期限临近
中国出口管制新闻较泛
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.summary_zh: 存在出口政策风险,但新闻较泛,且价格远低于去年,显示目前供应充足。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口期限及中国出口管制公告。

drivers: China export-control deadlines, incl. Nov 27 gallium
Rising indium prices and tight by-product supply
outlooks.summary: Export-control deadlines and tight by-product supply favour more upside. The price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so part of the shortage is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and licence decisions.
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制期限,包括11月27日镓相关期限
铟价上涨,副产品供应偏紧
价格3个月上涨67%
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制期限和副产品供应偏紧支持进一步上行。价格3个月已大涨67%,部分短缺已被计入。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月27日期限及中国的许可决定。

drivers: Chinese anode prices rising on feedstock
outlooks.summary: Mixed refinery news and a near-zero supply pressure score. Higher anode prices and freight add some support, but there is no clear shortage after a 15% price rise.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch coker run rates and anode-maker feedstock demand.
drivers_zh: 焦化装置重启抵消炼厂停产
中国预焙阳极因原料上涨而走高
运费高企
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂新闻多空交织,供应压力评分接近零。阳极价格和运费上升提供一定支撑,但价格已上涨15%,没有明确短缺。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注焦化装置开工率和阳极企业的原料需求。

outlooks.summary: The same mixed refinery and freight headlines apply. Supply pressure is near zero and the price is slightly lower over 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf Coast coker run rates and freight rates.
drivers_zh: 焦化装置重启抵消炼厂停产
运费挤压美国出口
价格3个月下跌5%
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂与运费新闻同样多空交织。供应压力接近零,价格3个月小幅走低。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸焦化装置开工率和运费。
